references.text: The contrast between Benjamin's initial strength (400,000 opponents versus 25,000 of their own) and their total defeat illustrates God's sovereignty over human military power.
Confirms and completes the narrative of Benjamin's defeat by specifying that the 25,000 who fell were the same ones described as brave warriors.
Provides necessary narrative context by showing Benjamin's earlier success, which explains the severity of the final confrontation in verse 17.
Part of the same narrative showing the gradual decline in Benjamin's strength before their final destruction.
